gpu_tip: ~31GB total at 128K context. An 8GB GPU (e.g. RTX 5060) plus a 32GB DDR5 kit is enough — the sparse MoE architecture means offloading the inactive experts barely costs any speed.
mac_tip: Needs ~31GB — a 32GB MacBook Pro (M4 Pro/Max or M5 Pro/Max) is right at the limit; a 36GB config is safer if available.
